main.description: Reports that a provisioned VM has come up on the network and is reachable (e.g. it registered its SSH key / fedproxy route and its policy engine answered).

address.description: Informational, non-routable address of the provisioned VM (a container or droplet IP), or a relay FQDN under the legacy tunnel/fedproxy-ssh transports. Never the guest's iroh ticket, its endpoint id, or any address that dials the guest: this record is world-readable and the ticket is the capability that reaches the guest's sshd.
